changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Add result_type column to quest_stage_options to support WIN/LOSE logic on individual options

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Make description optional in quest_stages (can be null if only title is used)

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Make target_stage_id nullable in quest_stage_options (for WIN/LOSE options that don't need a target)

changeSet.author: system
changeSet.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN quest_stage_options.result_type IS 'Result type for this option: NONE (continues to target stage), WIN (player wins), LOSE (player loses)'; COMMENT ON COLUMN quest_stages.description IS 'Optional description field - can be null if only title is used';

rollback.sql: COMMENT ON COLUMN quest_stage_options.result_type IS NULL; COMMENT ON COLUMN quest_stages.description IS NULL;
